Author: kittenhaswares-ui
Name: PulseQueue
Punchline: Held input repeats. Latest real press wins.
Description: A newest-input smart buffer with native logical-input Turbo and macro support.
Changelog: Replaces the ineffective manual Turbo path with native logical-input repeat inside FFXIV's standard-hotbar scan. FFXIV resolves the held binding, current action, target, and complete macro; PulseQueue no longer replays ExecuteSlot, actions, or parsed macro lines. A genuine newer press immediately preempts one older smart-buffer intent and exact owned queue, while injected or ReAction-delegated repeats never preempt. ReAction Turbo/Macro Queue are detected and delegated instead of blocking the plugin; NoClippy remains compatible. Timing is configurable from 0 to 1000 ms. Testing scope is standard hotbars, not cross hotbar/controller or direct clicks.
